pages.text: Full Belly: more max health, but slower.$(br2)Grill Fire: you hit harder and are harder to push.$(br2)Sugar Rush: faster walking and attacks.$(br2)Good Vibes: luck.

Tipsy: slower walking and attacks (drinks leave it).$(br2)Overstuffed: slow and weak (you ate too much).$(br2)Penalty Saver: more reach and softer falls.$(br2)Mate effects are in the "The mate" chapter.
